 Hazel Gandhi, USA TODAY NETWORK - New England Sat, November 7, 2026 at 11:04 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Friday's heavy rain , which triggered a National Weather Service flood watch for Cape Cod and Martha's Vineyard , is expected to continue into the weekend.
 Flooding on Route 28 and other roads in Falmouth Friday resulted in submerged cars and police asking people to avoid certain areas.
 Southeastern Massachusetts is expected to see 2 to 4 inches of rain from Nov. 6 - 8, with isolated amounts of 5 to 6 inches possible, according to Bryce Williams, a meteorologist at the NWS Norton office.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "Heaviest rain is going to be over Southeast Massachusetts, with 2 to 4 inches of rain widespread," Williams said.
 How much will it rain in Massachusetts?
 More rain is expected near Hyannis, Plymouth, Martha's Vineyard and Brockton during the period of heavy rainfall. Most of the rain will subside by mid-morning Saturday, but scattered showers and cloudy weather are expected, according to the NWS.
 The National Weather Service has issued a flood watch for parts of Massachusetts and Rhode Island this weekend. Temperatures on Saturday will be in the lower 60s in Massachusetts, and will continue to fall through Nov. 8, when highs will reach the upper 50s No services are expected to be disrupted as a result of the potential flood, the NWS said.
 National Weather Service Hyannis forecast
 Saturday: Rain and possibly a thunderstorm before 2 p.m., then a slight chance of rain between 2 p.m. and 3 p.m. Patchy fog. High near 63. South wind 6 to 8 mph becoming north in the morning. Chance of precipitation is 80%. New precipitation amounts between a quarter and half of an inch possible.
 Advertisement Advertisement Saturday night: A slight chance of rain after 3 a.m. Partly cloudy, with a low around 45. West wind 6 to 15 mph, with gusts as high as 26 mph. Chance of precipitation is 20%.
 Sunday: Mostly sunny, with a high near 59. West wind 11 to 15 mph, with gusts as high as 28 mph.
 Sunday night: Mostly clear, with a low around 47. West wind 8 to 10 mph, with gusts as high as 20 mph.
 Monday: Sunny, with a high near 57. West wind 11 to 14 mph.
 Monday night: Mostly clear, with a low around 39. West wind 10 to 13 mph.
